I haven't the faintest idea as to who might be behind this, but...
虽然不知道是谁干的……
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Basement Entrance
呼啸山庄 地下室入口

dataList.content:
... man, someone really doesn't want us reaching the basement.
哎，看来是无论如何都想阻止我们进入地下室……

We're finding more and more Peccatula the closer we get to the entrance.
越是靠近入口，罪种的数量就越多啊。

Since we haven't come across any other entrances on our way down... I guess the only place they could be coming from is the basement.
这里也没有别的通道……我觉得它们只能是从地下室里不断涌出的了。

What... the heck are they keeping in this basement...?
到底……在地下室里藏着什么……

Don't the rich families with big mansions usually keep basements for...
但是通常来说……在这种大宅邸里……建地下室的话……

... fancy, classy stuff like fermenting some good whiskey?
不都是为了那什么吗？比如用来酿造上好的威士忌之类的……

They also use 'em for storing treasures... Hehe, I have many fond memories of raiding their basements.
也能当做保管大额资产的仓库……嘻嘻，洗劫起来可有意思了。

Hmm... It probably depends on the family, but if a rich family wanted to hide something they're doing, they'd do it in the basement.
嗯……虽然每个有钱人家都会有所不同……但如果想要藏匿什么东西，地下室应该是最合适的。

Can you check the diary again, Heath? Maybe something new appeared on the pages like it did earlier.
希斯。再翻开日记看看吧。说不定会像刚刚那样显示出之前看不见的部分？

It can't possibly be that easy. This is just a diary, nothing more. You can ask these papers all you want, but—
哪儿有那么简单！这就是一本日记，哪怕问它让我们来地下室的理由也……

<... Is there something wrong with the diary, Heathcliff?>
<希斯克利夫，你怎么突然目不转睛地看起日记本了？>

I felt an odd sensation earlier. I dismissed it, thought it was just the chills.
刚刚……我以为是错觉就没有在意。

But I just felt it again.
现在我又感觉到了。

This diary... I ain't even sure how to put it... haah. The point is, I just had the strangest sensation.
我手里这本日记。该怎么说呢……唉，总之就是觉得怪怪的。

The same feeling I felt earlier when that glass window suddenly shattered all on its own.
刚刚窗户突然碎掉吓我一跳的时候也有过差不多的感觉。

Heathcliff, if I may...
希斯克利夫，有一种可能。

I know! I know I must sound like I've gone barmy. But...
我知道！这听起来像是疯言疯语吧？！但是……

No, Heathcliff. It appears rather obvious that the ink used to write the entries was not an ordinary ink.
不，希斯克利夫。那本日记一定不是平平无奇用一般的墨水写下的。

There is a small chance that your 'suspicions' may be true. That is what I believe.
你的“疑惑”也许才是事实，我如此认为。

What are you two even talking about...?
你们二位，是在说什么……

I would like to recommend that you open the diary yourself, Heathcliff.
希斯克利夫，我建议你亲手翻阅它。

Heathcliff opened the diary with a somber expression...
希斯克利夫一脸凝重地打开日记……

... and once again, the ink stains on the page had transformed into a series of legible alphabets.
纸上的墨迹又一次在不知不觉间变成了文字。

XX/XX
X月X日

I once had a dream.
我做了梦。

A dream of my own death, or an eternal slumber.
梦见我突然死去，又或者是陷入永眠……

I found myself in heaven upon my waking.
当我睁开眼，发现自己到了天堂。

It was just as it was described in the books. I was surrounded by angels who sang a song for me.
和在书中看见的一样。天使们围着我唱起歌。

But at that moment, I also understood that I belonged elsewhere.
随后我顿悟，那儿并不是我该在的地方。

I cried and pleaded with the angels to send me back...
我哭得很伤心，央求天使们送我回去……

And the angels were so furious that they cast me out from heaven back into the middle of the violet flowers on top of Wuthering Heights.
而天使们大为愤怒，就把我扔到生满紫色花朵的呼啸山庄顶上。

Only then did I truly awake in this world, sobbing for joy.
我就在那儿醒过来，高兴得直哭。

Now that I reminisce upon that memory...
而且……如今回想起来……

... I no longer believe that it was a mere dream.
我不认为，那单单只是一场梦。

It was just as real as the ghost from my youth that I have seen haunting this very manor...
正如我不认为小时候在这宅邸看见的幽灵，只是自己的幻觉……

Yes. If we were in heaven, we shall be eternally miserable.
没错，如果我们在天堂，一定会非常凄惨吧。

Thus we must embrace the encroaching sins and descend into the world beneath.
因此我们只得承受即将来临的罪孽，堕落至深渊之底。

Here it is again. The 'we'...
这里又提到了。“我们”……

Most diaries are written in first person. Do you know anything about this, Heathcliff?
通常来说日记一般都会使用第一人称才对吧。你知道些什么吗，希斯克利夫先生？

No... She's never once mentioned this dream to me.
不知道……我，头一次听说这个梦。

Though it may be baseless conjecture...
虽说可能是臆测……

But to say that we must "embrace the encroaching sins and descend into the world beneath"...
其中提及的“承受即将来临的罪孽，堕落至深渊之底”……

... Perhaps the diary means to instruct us to face the Peccatula and continue to descend into the basement.
对我而言，那听起来就像是在让我们将这些罪种尽数击败并前往地下室。

You're saying that Catherine... planned all this?
难道你是指凯瑟琳……安排了这一切？

Mm. Though I remain uncertain if this is what Miss Faust had implied earlier, yet...
嗯。此外，虽不知这与浮士德女士的猜想是否相符。

... Heathcliff, did it not appear to you that the diary is answering directly to your beckoning?
希斯克利夫先生……这日记是否像是在回应你的呼唤？

... Right, it's not just me who felt that, then?
……看样子，不止我一个这么想啊？

Miss Catherine, she...
那位凯瑟琳小姐……

I don't want to speak so ill of the dead, but she seems a bit...
我知道对逝者这么说不大好，但她好像有点……

Yes, she was quite the character. And she could be a tad frightening, from time to time.
嗯，她偶尔古怪到会让人觉得诡异。

... Nelly. Linton said... something about my letters being burned at the incinerator, didn't he?
……耐莉，刚刚林顿……那家伙说他把我寄来的信全扔进了焚化炉。

You think he's really the prick who nicked all my letters before they reached Cathy?
把我的信全拦下来的……真的是那家伙吗？

Well... I wouldn't put such behavior beyond Master Linton.
应该是，林顿大人他……应该有充分的动机。
